claims.claim: Contracts Finder lets users search public contract opportunities.
claims.quote: You can use Contracts Finder to: search for contract opportunities in different sectors
claims.note: The service page expressly offers contract opportunity search.

claims.claim: Contracts Finder lets users look up previous tenders and contracts.
claims.quote: look up details of previous tenders and contracts
claims.note: The service page expressly offers past tender and contract lookup.

claims.claim: Contracts Finder publishes award information for in-scope procurements under the previous rules.
claims.quote: As set out under the introduction and scope, there are a number of circumstances where contract award information still needs to be published on Contracts Finder.
claims.note: The transitional guidance identifies continuing award publication on Contracts Finder for its in-scope procurements.

claims.claim: The relevant previous rules cover procurements begun before 24 February 2025.
claims.quote: This guidance only applies to procurements commenced before 24 February 2025 under the PCRs.
claims.note: The guidance defines the earlier-regulation scope and cutoff date.

claims.claim: New procurements use Find a Tender for notices.
claims.quote: Any procurements whether above or below threshold commenced from 24 February 2025 only require notices to be published on FTS.
claims.note: The guidance routes notices for procurements begun from that date to Find a Tender.

claims.claim: Contracts Finder is free to use.
claims.quote: Contracts Finder is free to use and is accessible here: http://www.gov.uk/contracts-finder
claims.note: The guidance expressly says the service is free.

claims.claim: Contracts Finder can be used to search public contract opportunities.
claims.quote: You can use Contracts Finder to: search for contract opportunities in different sectors
claims.note: The service page states that users can search opportunities.

claims.claim: Contracts Finder remains in use for in-scope procurements begun under the previous regulations before 24 February 2025.
claims.quote: This guidance only applies to procurements commenced before 24 February 2025 under the PCRs.
claims.note: The transitional Contracts Finder guidance continues to apply to the in-scope earlier procurements it identifies.

claims.claim: New procurements under the Procurement Act 2023 are published on Find a Tender.
claims.quote: Any procurements whether above or below threshold commenced from 24 February 2025 only require notices to be published on FTS.
claims.note: The source directs required notices for new procurements to Find a Tender.

claims.claim: Notices for new public procurements are published on Find a Tender.
claims.quote: Any procurements whether above or below threshold commenced from 24 February 2025 only require notices to be published on FTS.
claims.note: The source names Find a Tender as the notice platform for procurements begun under the new regime.
